executionRecoveryMethods.recursiveDescent: Seeded at observed API continuations and followed direct transfers to the bounded dispatcher/branch blocks; stopped at computed dispatch where targets depend on runtime state.
executionRecoveryMethods.basicBlockGraph: Recovered the two RSMB return blocks, shared dispatcher tail targets, lock-loop edges, the EBX bit-test branch, and API-return helper edges.
executionRecoveryMethods.directBranchTargets: Direct JMPs from observed continuations and conditional successors were decoded with Capstone.
executionRecoveryMethods.callTargetDiscovery: No adjacent call instruction ends at the observed API return RVAs in the preceding 15 bytes; call/wrapper identity remains unresolved. Call-next and indirect dispatch patterns were recorded separately.
executionRecoveryMethods.stackConsistency: Repeated RSP arithmetic, stack swaps, and [RSP] moves appear in the continuations; no stable prologue/epilogue or function frame was established.
executionRecoveryMethods.prologueEpilogueHeuristics: Common x64 prologue signatures had zero hits at listed exception-range starts in sections 0 and 13; this is a bounded heuristic, not a function-absence result.
executionRecoveryMethods.returnSiteClustering: 74 observations (58 distinct RVAs) from one saved trace profile; all miss listed exception ranges, while multiple API groups tail-jump to shared targets.
executionRecoveryMethods.indirectDispatch: jmp qword ptr [RAX] at 0x4ebdde7 reads a .dungeon data slot whose value is materialized as an absolute address in the focused trace.
executionRecoveryMethods.runtimeWrittenCode: No instruction-byte change was found at the sampled continuation, branch, dispatcher, or indirect-target instructions; one dispatch-data qword changed during the conditional emulation.
executionRecoveryMethods.confidencePolicy: No single heuristic assigns function identity; dispatcher/helper labels are candidates only.

listedExceptionRangeStarts.interpretation: A zero hit count is a bounded heuristic result and does not establish that no function exists.

stableGameCodeSearch.conclusion: No stable UE4/Dungeons function or native registration candidate met the evidence threshold. This bounded negative result does not prove the executable contains no such code.

limitations: The archive distribution authenticity is unverified; hashes pin local identity only.
The static bytes come from the saved 15,360,000-byte Stage 1 output, not a full reconstructed executable.
All branch register comparisons are Unicorn counterfactuals with synthetic API results, not Windows observations.
The API callsites may be wrapper/tail-call dispatched; an API return RVA is not treated as a function entry.
Unwind-range misses and unreadable unwind-info RVAs do not imply that code is not a function.
